name: labs/thorlabs__light_analysis_examples
title: Thorlabs BC207/BC210 beam profiler (TLBC2.py)
intro: Thorlabs BC207/BC210 beam profiler (TLBC2.py), adapted from thorlabs/light_analysis_examples. It reads `sensor_pixels_x`, `sensor_pixels_y`, `pixel_pitch_horizontal`, `pixel_pitch_vertical` and 5 more; sets `exposure_time`, `wavelength`, `precision_mode` and `binning`; runs `capture` and `measure_beam`. `capture`: capture a single image from a named camera with a declared resolution and exposure and return an image artifact reference. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
